title: Queued proposals can price the guardian out of pausing

source.licenceUse: The repository is fetched at run time at the pinned commit and never committed here. finding.json, report.md and poc.patch are Verdikta's own words and code, as are the prior findings and known issues beside them.
source.adaptedHow: A test of our own, written from the finding's description, that asserts what the hunter says should hold, so it fails while the behaviour is present. The finding's test logs the gas of a hundred thousand proposals with no assertion; this one queues enough to pass a 30 million gas block, and asserts the limit.

program.name: Code4rena
program.verdict: Valid at the lower class: labelled 2 (Med Risk), downgraded by judge, satisfactory, selected for report, published as M-01.

label.why: The judge held that the attack does not fit in one block and that the guardian can act before it is done, so Medium; wardens argued in the comments for High, and it stayed Medium.

boundary.moved: Submitted as 3 (High Risk). Judge GalloDaSballo changed it to 2 (Med Risk) on 2024-10-30.

expected.classReason: The PoC shows the guardian's pause needing more than a 30 million gas block once 2,500 proposals are queued: Timelock.pause walks every live proposal, so the safe's signers can make its gas grow without bound. A theft would also need stolen signer keys and a guardian that waits while the queue grows over several blocks, which the PoC does not show: unbounded gas consumption, Medium.
expected.reason: The program judged it valid at the lower side of a boundary it moved, so Medium, against the High claimed. Every gate passes, and the class is left to the jury, which A7d measures.
